lines.3: 「If I'm involved, we're going for first place.」
lines.10: 「For fairness, I shall check it too.」
lines.11: Inori and the headmaster peered at the card.
lines.12: 「...She does not qualify. Though I suppose she comes fairly close.」
lines.13: 「Why not? Doesn't it say something like 'a beautiful blonde' or 'a cool girl'?」
lines.16: 「I believe you owe me a satisfactory explanation.」
lines.18: 「With all those hopeless people lined up, why did you deliberately choose me?」
lines.19: 「I just wanted to run with you... Guh!」
lines.20: 「Honestly. You threw away a race we could have won...」
lines.21: 「Listen. If you're going to compete, you win. Try something this stupid again and I'll step on you.」
